The /app/frontend Vite app that the preview serves was untouched, and the preview app behaves exactly as in iteration_1 — no JS errors, no regressions. All 6 flows from the review request pass.

critical_code_review_comments: Google OAuth on web works via Supabase (supabase.ts signInGoogleWeb). For the native Android APK sign-in failure the user reports, the fix is not in the web app but in the Android/Capacitor configuration: (a) ensure the Google Cloud OAuth Android client has the release keystore SHA-1 fingerprint registered, (b) use @capacitor/google-auth or a native intent flow (not window.location redirect) inside the APK, and (c) configure the WebView/Capacitor server URL and allowNavigation whitelist for accounts.google.com. This cannot be verified in a browser preview — needs a physical device + Google Cloud console access.

The review request references data-testid values 'creators-panel' and 'support-panel' as first-class checks; these testids only exist inside the tab body and only render when the tab is active (tab list is horizontally scrollable). This is fine but worth documenting for future automation.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded admin + pre-existing support threads.
